title: Riot Squad Melon Menthol Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Riot Squad Melon Menthol Shortfill 50ml E-Liquid is a perfect blend of succulent, ripe melon and refreshing menthol. This Melon Menthol E Liquid offers an authentic and rich melon flavour that is reminiscent of plump, juicy melons picked straight from the vine. The sweetness of the melon is subtle, providing a natural sweetness that is perfectly balanced with the cool and refreshing menthol. Whilst the splash of menthol provides a nice coolness that gives a frosty sensation to the throat, perfectly complementing the sweet melon flavour. This Melon Menthol by Riot Squad 50ml E-Liquid is perfect for menthol and melon vape flavour lovers. Offering a unique and delicious combination that creates a sweet and refreshing vape experience. If you’re looking for a balanced and satisfying vape that packs a cool and fruity punch. Don’t wait to get your hands on a bottle of Riot Squad Melon Menthol Shortfill 50ml E-Liquid today, to experience the ultimate in melon menthol vaping! This delicious Shortfill is also available as a Riot Squad Nic Salt. Which is perfect for vapers looking to soothe their nicotine cravings with a super smooth throat hit. Don’t miss out, check out the equally delicious Riot Squad Melon Menthol Nic Salt today! This convenient Riot Squad 50ml nicotine-free Shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a Nicotine Shot to tailor your vape to your liking. For example, adding an 18mg Nic Shot will turn your 50ml Riot Squad Shortfills into 50ml of 3mg E Liquid. What’s more, this Riot Squad Shortfill features a 70VG/30PG ratio. Making it ideal for Sub-Ohm Vape Kits. As it’s the perfect E Liquid ratio for large cloud creation that doesn’t lessen your vape juice flavour. Allowing you to enjoy your favourite Riot Squad flavours to the max. Using naturally derived vegetable glycerine and propylene glycol with pharmaceutical-grade nicotine. So if you are looking for delicious flavour and high-quality E-Liquids for your vapes, you can be confident the Riot Squad UK-based E-Liquid manufacturer will deliver premium, flavourful vapour clouds and explosively delicious flavours in every puff!
